study.question: Can a small parallel logit residual carrying the count-shrink source's eight exclusive history groups improve the intact relation-content source under the frozen recipe, and are any gains attributable to additional task-feedback products and count interpolation rather than uniform-content capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0006-relation_count (0.8271699021) and its fixed control (0.8271383506) are below entry 0.8275704846. Aligned early injection in g2-r0007-aligned_early_count (0.8255833650) is below both source bests and its fixed control (0.8256463767); late injection is also worse (0.8245006440 / 0.8244113714). These are successful executions with negative quality results, not missing data or runtime failures. The count source has higher buy AUC (0.8970811065 vs entry 0.8941992645) and history>64 macro-AUC (0.8515903610 vs 0.8502786780), while entry leads overall and on click/cart/fav. Provisional explanation: some complementary feedback evidence may be easier to use through a separate low-dimensional correction than by modifying every relation token or widening every original tower. Preserve the backbone and start an added branch at zero output. The narrower tested mechanism is whether uniform content-feedback products add predictive value beyond marginals and whether count-dependent interpolation adds beyond fixed interpolation. Prior single-seed near-null count contrasts do not establish reliability calibration or prove that representation interference caused the losses.

nearest_work.difference: Backbone inherited byte-equivalent through original tower feature construction; add a separate residual before sigmoid rather than changing token content or tower width. Source SHA256 104b2f7f80fcee51fa61079bf1880184ca383b94eaa6059c7d2d2a1000e2935d verified.

Inherit eight exclusive category/brand by last-16-position groups, uniform mean keys, four overlapping historical-feedback fractions and n/(n+4) user-background shrinkage. Reuse only projected-key products/fractions/counts in a small residual; do not replicate its complete model, its value-slot projection, ReLU DIN scorer or original concatenated towers. Source SHA256 765506b641969f7b0e6134728842d3592739eace697a97c5f38c638e7cb9ef77 verified.

Prior early/late variants share 35 overlapping relation-quartile feedback increments mixed into original tokens. Proposed branch uses the other source's eight disjoint groups and its own readout, without modifying original tokens. Route, grouping, dimensions and initialization all differ, so improvement against this trial alone cannot attribute benefit to bypass placement.

Archived primary text 1706.06978v4 lines 271-277 inspected: source deliberately retains unnormalized activation magnitude; this remains unchanged. Proposed branch uses uniform group means and count-dependent feedback gates in addition to that existing path. No exact original-DIN reproduction or novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add Bx8x4x8 projected mean-key feedback products, Bx8x4 raw local fractions and Bx8 normalized counts (296 columns) to a separate Linear(296,64)-SiLU-Linear(64,4) residual. Add its outputs to the original four logits before sigmoid. Projection is Linear(96,8,bias=False) at the released six-field schema. Construct new modules after the original reset and token-identity initialization; initialize the final residual weight/bias to zero and multiply residual by nonempty-history indicator. All arms initially reduce to the same source predictor under matched common state. Product-count versus product-fixed changes only local/background product interpolation. Marginal control replaces the gate with ones, retaining local fractions. Content/count control also replaces fraction columns with repeated normalized counts. This control matches nominal parameters, not information rank or activation scale. The extra branch can still alter shared-embedding gradients during training; zero initialization preserves the starting function, not an independent backbone training trajectory. No learned reliability, Bayesian posterior calibration or new-method priority is asserted.
predictions: If complementary feedback information survives this integration, residual_count will exceed stronger source macro-AUC 0.8275704845768582 under the same full protocol. Compare to the other source 0.8272805336635536 and baseline 0.8099233880793816 as well; do not substitute buy-only improvement for macro selection.

If count interpolation contributes, residual_count will exceed residual_fixed on validation macro-AUC, with paired-seed confirmation before claiming repeated support. Exact interpolation equality is predicted at n=4 and whenever local and user-background fractions coincide.

If multiplicative products add utility beyond marginals, residual_count will exceed residual_marginal. If added explicit task feedback is useful, a feedback arm will exceed residual_content. A marginal-only winner supports additional feedback, not a need for factorized products.

Exploratory history-length pattern: source complementarity suggests inspecting buy and >64 histories, but these are not new independent confirmatory tests. Reuse predefined 0,1-16,17-64,>64 bins with sample/positive/negative counts and report all tasks and regressions. The empty-history slice has only 13 buy positives and is weak evidence.

New residual is identically zero at initialization and for empty histories. Masked fields/actions/task-mask entries and current action cannot change outputs with common state. The content control must be invariant to added historical task-mask changes, while core historical action dependence remains allowed.

Parameter addition is 20,036 in all four variants; runtime may rise despite only +0.06082% parameters. Measure training/inference time, batch latency, peak memory and throughput rather than infer efficiency from parameter count.
falsifiers: No feedback arm exceeds the stronger frozen source under the declared selection rule: no successful compatibility result for this implementation. Preserve all earlier negative trajectories; do not reinterpret the weak-source or buy-only gains as overall success.
The content/count residual matches or exceeds feedback variants: additional branch capacity or uniform content is a viable explanation, not task-feedback mechanism support.

The marginal control matches or exceeds the product candidate: multiplicative product necessity is unsupported. A fixed interpolation match/win leaves the count-specific explanation unsupported even if the architecture improves overall.

Gains disappear or reverse over paired seeds, or plausible paired user-cluster uncertainty spans no gain: retain preliminary/uncertain claims. One seed or a single improvement cannot establish a mechanism.

Forward/backward failure, BF16 nonfinite values, missing output tasks, current-label leakage, masked-payload sensitivity or unexpected initialization changes invalidate that arm pending a charged fix; a failure is not a scientific negative result.

No measured quality/cost advantage over the stronger source, or training/inference overhead larger than the provisional 500-second unit estimate: reject the efficiency prediction and revise feasibility before further calls.
alternative_explanations: Shared-embedding gradients, random initialization, single-pass optimization or seed noise may explain both prior losses and any new gain. The branch shares embeddings and is not a frozen ensemble.

Main-source relation counts and historical action embeddings may already carry the relevant feedback; extra task fractions may be redundant. Count/fixed differences have been tiny or negative in prior trajectories.

Changing from 35 overlapping relation/quartile groups to eight disjoint category/brand old/recent groups, using uniform means, changing activation geometry and zero-start residual optimization co-vary against previous fusions. This suite does not isolate bypass placement as a causal mechanism.
Raw local fractions remain visible to both product-count and product-fixed networks; the readout can partly reconstruct count-dependent interactions, weakening this contrast.

Marginal/control feature columns have different scale and effective rank despite equal registered parameters and active modules; matched parameter count alone does not fully equate functional capacity. Repeated results or a later scale/representation control would be needed for stronger attribution.
The user-background rate contains the local slot and is not an independent prior; a four-event strength is a predeclared heuristic, not a calibrated uncertainty estimate.
Whole-window filtering/vocabularies, static publisher snapshots, official_offline delayed feedback and category/brand 24h auxiliary labels limit production or advertisement-attribution conclusions.

cost_plan.stop_rule: Host must gate source equality at initialization/common state, masking, shapes, finite loss/backward and BF16 before scoring. Stop an invalid arm and retain charged failure receipt; no duplicate execution with unknown state. Re-estimate after first measured complete-unit cost and stop before spending reserved attribution/assessment time or the fixed 43,200s campaign deadline. If no admissible discriminating experiment fits remaining resources, retain incumbent and report unresolved/negative results; exhausted resources are not success.
